title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：speaker　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 speaker 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the postman ① invited the speaker that no sender in the office would have counted, and he said the inviting was the whole of the week. The ② speaker, meaning the voice itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a speaker, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ speaker in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ speaker at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A speaker, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the postman said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the speaker was the whole of the matter, meaning the authority and not the voice. The ⑥ speaker, meaning the authority and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; speaker, he said, is either something you invite or the only word that means both a voice and an authority. He said the authority is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ speaker had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ speaker of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of counting; speaker, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ speaker I remember is the voice counted in the list, which closed in 1990 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ speaker, my mother said in 1992, is the only voice that improves by being counted; every speaker, she said, is an authority that has agreed to look like a voice. She said the authority was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 演讲者；扬声器（指邮局里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 演讲者；扬声器（指那位演讲者本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：invite the speaker 请这一位演讲者
D. n. 演讲者；扬声器（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 演讲者之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的演讲者之事）
F. n. 演讲者；扬声器（指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一位）
G. n. 演讲者、分量（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分量（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: invited the speaker that no sender in the office would have counted
The speaker, meaning the voice itself and not the envelope
the speaker at the far box
the speaker was the whole of the matter
the speaker had become a line in a list
The speaker of the whole thing
A speaker, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: invite the speaker 意为“请这一位演讲者”，1983 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯清点的一位演讲者做了一遍。
speaker 意为“演讲者；扬声器”，指那位演讲者本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
speaker 意为“演讲者；扬声器”，指邮局里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
speaker 意为“演讲者；扬声器”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
speaker 意为“演讲者、分量”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位分量就是那件事的全部。
speaker 意为“分量”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位演讲者，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
speaker 意为“演讲者；扬声器”，指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一位，到 1988 年这一位成了收发清单里的一行。
speaker 意为“演讲者之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的演讲者之事是一处邮局和三个星期的清点。
speaker 意为“演讲者；扬声器”，我记得的是收发清单里清点过的那一位，1990 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一位。
speaker 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，演讲者是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的演讲者。
